# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 5,784 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 3,184 MCP servers. Checked daily, 3,171 of 3,180 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-13. +4 listed, not yet checked. Handshake check: 200 of 1,766 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 66 answered with a tools list, 131 asked for auth, 3 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT. Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

<!-- mcp-reach:start -->

## MCP server reachability

Checked daily, 3,171 of 3,180 checked servers live, last checked 2026-11-13. +4 listed, not yet checked.

Handshake check: 200 of 1,766 remote servers checked so far. Of those, 66 answered with a tools list, 131 asked for auth, 3 failed. This is the initialize + tools/list probe, updated daily around 7:15 AM Pacific, separate from the link check around 7 AM PT.

Once a day, AgentScout requests every MCP server in the directory, including catalog-only listings, and, when it is a different link, its GitHub URL. The request is HEAD, then GET, with a 20-second timeout. If that fails on TLS or gets no response, it retries once with a browser user agent. A server counts as live when its stored label is OK or Reachable, blocks automated checks. OK is HTTP 200-399 or 405, and also 401, 403 or 429 when the GitHub URL succeeded or that URL is the only one checked. Reachable, blocks automated checks means those 401, 403 or 429 responses without a harder error. Any other checked result is not live. The live percentage uses only servers with a row in the check file: live plus down. A server with no row is listed, not yet checked, and is not part of that percentage. Catalog-only listings stay unverified until that daily check opens them. The last-checked time is the checked field, in America/Los_Angeles. The rows are on the MCP status page and in status.json.

- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): the same reachability rows, with HTTP result and history
- [status.json](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): machine-readable rows for every listed MCP server
- [Best MCP servers by task](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/): ranked lists, with the same daily check

<!-- mcp-reach:end -->

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp. AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-13 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 3,184 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-12 to 2026-11-13): 68

- [stack-diagram](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/stack-diagram.html) (added 2026-11-13): stack-diagram is an MIT-licensed agent skill that turns one sentence describing your stack into an architecture diagram with the official logos of each service, for example Next.js and Hono on Vercel with Postgres on Neon, Clerk and Stripe. It installs with npx skills add for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other skill-aware agents, or as a zip in the Claude apps.
- [Insomnia](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/insomnia.html) (added 2026-11-13): Insomnia is an MIT-licensed macOS menu-bar app that keeps an Apple Silicon MacBook awake, including with the lid closed, for a timed session so long agent runs are not cut off by sleep. You set how long it stays awake and what happens when the lid closes, and it reports anything it could not undo; it is experimental and needs macOS 26 or later.
- [Synthadoc](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/synthadoc.html) (added 2026-11-13): Synthadoc is an AGPL-3.0 LLM knowledge compilation engine that turns raw documents into a structured, local-first, human-readable wiki as an alternative to traditional RAG. The knowledge base keeps itself accurate as documents accumulate through autonomous self-optimization, and it is aimed at individuals, teams and enterprises.
- [ShipSwift](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/shipswift.html) (added 2026-11-13): ShipSwift is an MIT-licensed, AI-native SwiftUI component library with agent skills: one command gives your coding agent production-ready SwiftUI components, animations, Metal shaders, charts and full-stack modules to build iOS apps from, and an MCP server and a searchable catalog at shipswift.app expose the source. A showcase app previews every component on device.
- [OPC Skills](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/opc-skills.html) (added 2026-11-13): OPC Skills is an Apache-2.0 pack of agent skills for solopreneurs and one-person companies that extends Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents with self-contained SKILL.md workflows: SEO and GEO for AI search, demand research on Reddit, X and GitHub, domain hunting with registrar price comparison, logo and banner creation and image generation.
- [dbt Charts](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dbt-charts.html) (added 2026-11-13): dbt Charts from dbt Labs is an Apache-2.0 declarative YAML syntax around SQL for dashboards: you keep SQL for what data to show and describe how to show it in YAML, and the dct CLI compiles board definitions into interactive dashboards and reports. It is designed so agents can write dashboards that humans can audit, with an agent skill (dct skills chart) and an MCP page.
- [Tobs](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tobs.html) (added 2026-11-13): Tobs (formerly DeepSeekBot) is an MIT-licensed plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives you a team of personal bots with their own identities, personalities, permissions and long-term memory. You create bots for research, writing or coding, chat with them or put them in groups, schedule work, and let them answer as themselves in Slack, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ and WeChat, using the model provider you set in DeepSeek Harness.
- [affectUI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/affectui.html) (added 2026-11-13): affectUI is an MIT-licensed library of React components for agent apps, covering runs, tool calls, traces, handoffs, approvals and context, plus inputs, menus, charts and screens for the rest of the app. Each component is one .tsx file with its styles inside, installed with the shadcn CLI or added by Claude Code, Cursor or Codex through its MCP server; some items are in a paid Pro tier.
- [67js](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/67js.html) (added 2026-11-13): 67js is an MIT-licensed 3D engine built for AI agents to drive: an agent builds and edits a scene, kept as plain data, through its MCP server, checks PNG previews and renders stills or MP4 video. It has a WebGL2 real-time rasterizer, a CPU, WebGL2 or Vulkan path tracer and addons for terrain, vegetation, characters, liquid and vehicles.
- [Kinetograph](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kinetograph.html) (added 2026-11-13): Kinetograph is an Apache-2.0 programmatic video engine made for agents: you or a coding agent write a video in TypeScript with Remotion's API or as a plain HTML page, Node runs the code and a Rust GPU compositor draws every frame without a browser, including CSS, SVG, Canvas, WebGL shaders, 3D and Web Audio. Existing Remotion and HyperFrames projects render as they are; it is in beta and installs from npm.
- [TasteCode](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tastecode.html) (added 2026-11-13): TasteCode is an Apache-2.0 desktop workspace for AI coding agents aimed at creative work: it runs Codex, Claude Code and Grok in one app while keeping orchestration, terminal access, diffs, checkpoints and history on your machine, and adds a Design Mode for inspecting and editing web interfaces. It is an early beta for Windows and macOS.
- [SoduWork](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/soduwork.html) (added 2026-11-13): SoduWork is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted engine for teams and their agents: a request ends only when the person who asked signs off, with one harness doing the work and another reviewing it. It works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Qwen Code, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness and others, and starts as a desktop app on macOS, Linux or Windows.
- [kwant](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kwant.html) (added 2026-11-13): kwant is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted team of AI bots in one binary: bots share chats, hand work to each other with an @mention, run on schedules and post tasks to a Mission board, where a task only turns Verified when kwant runs the check itself. It keeps separate spaces for work and home with their own accounts and approvals, and runs as a Mac, Linux or Windows app or on a server with your Claude or Codex subscription.
- [Kept](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kept.html) (added 2026-11-13): Kept is an AGPL-3.0 self-hosted inventory of everything you own and where it is: homes, garages and storage units down to shelves and boxes, with receipts, manuals, warranties and history, a 3D map and a graph view. It has a built-in AI assistant and MCP server using the AI provider you choose, no telemetry, and runs on Docker Compose or Kubernetes.
- [Deep Code CLI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/deep-code-cli.html) (added 2026-11-13): Deep Code CLI is an MIT-licensed terminal coding assistant tuned for DeepSeek V4 models, with deep-thinking mode, reasoning-effort control, agent skills and MCP integration. You install it from npm, point it at the DeepSeek API or another base URL in a settings file it shares with the Deep Code VS Code extension, and run deepcode in any project.
- [Agent of Empires](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agent-of-empires.html) (added 2026-11-13): Agent of Empires is an MIT-licensed session manager for AI coding agents on Linux and macOS: it runs Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and others in parallel across branches, each in a persistent tmux session with optional git worktree and Docker, Podman or Apple Containers isolation. You monitor and review diffs from a TUI, a CLI, an HTTP API or a phone-friendly web dashboard.
- [UI SDK](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ui-sdk.html) (added 2026-11-13): UI SDK is Vercel Labs' Apache-2.0 library of behaviors for agents that build user interfaces: keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag and drop and the ARIA they need live in @ui-sdk/core, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components. It ships an agent skill (npx skills add vercel-labs/ui) so coding agents compose consistent components from those behaviors; it is in beta.
- [OKDOC AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/okdoc-ai.html) (added 2026-11-13): OKDOC AI is a smart e-signature tool for quotes and contracts: you upload a document or generate one from a prompt, send it for signature, and see who opened it, how long they read and where they stalled, with WhatsApp alerts and automatic reminders. It can collect payment once the client signs, and it is free to start.
- [Fluxtail](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fluxtail.html) (added 2026-11-13): Fluxtail is centralized log management you drive from your AI tools: its hosted MCP server lets Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI or VS Code with Copilot search logs, investigate errors and manage streams, receivers and sources, and a browser Live Tail shows logs as they arrive. Plans start at $19 a month, with a 14-day trial and no card required.
- [VibeListing](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vibelisting.html) (added 2026-11-13): VibeListing is an AI Shopify app that turns raw product photos, supplier URLs or product ideas into ready-to-sell listings, with virtual try-on product images, SEO titles and optimized descriptions you preview and then publish to your store. A free plan is available, and paid plans start at $29 a month.
- [CloudGPU Compute](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cloudgpu-compute.html) (added 2026-11-13): CloudGPU Compute lets AI agents rent GPUs through a REST API and an MCP server: an agent can browse the public GPU catalog, get a quote, receive its own key through an owner-approved connect link, and run jobs or instances with server-enforced spending and time limits. Results must be exported and validated before the instance is destroyed, and GPUs are billed by the minute.
- [Halloween AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/halloween-ai.html) (added 2026-11-13): Halloween AI turns a selfie or pet photo into a Halloween costume portrait in a minute or two, painting the costume, makeup and a spooky background around your own face, with around 30 looks including pet costumes. Your first portrait is free; one-time credit packs start at $5.99 and failed runs are refunded.
- [SearchByVideo](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/searchbyvideo.html) (added 2026-11-13): SearchByVideo searches inside your own videos with AI: you describe a moment, an object or on-screen text and it returns the matching scenes with timestamps ranked by confidence, including on silent footage, so you can jump straight to them. You can try a live sample free; Pro costs $24.99 a month or $99.99 a year.
- [Two Mountains](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/two-mountains.html) (added 2026-11-13): Two Mountains is an AI reflection companion for overthinking and sleepless nights: you write the thought that keeps returning and receive a personal letter that answers it from two angles, Laozi's Taoism and Marcus Aurelius's Stoicism. The first three letters are free; Companion costs $9.80 a month or $79 a year, and a one-time 7-Day Reset is $19.
- [Vistella](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/vistella.html) (added 2026-11-13): Vistella is an AI image generation and editing platform: you describe an idea or upload an image and create portraits, product visuals, artwork, illustrations or architecture with a choice of publicly listed third-party models, online or through one developer API. Pricing is usage-based, with credit packs from $5 that do not expire.
- [Enzo Celebration](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/enzo-celebration.html) (added 2026-11-13): Enzo Celebration turns one photo into an 8-second vertical AI video of a viral football celebration, such as Enzo Fernandez's hands-behind-the-ears move, with generated crowd sound. Each video costs one credit, from $6.90, with no subscription, and a failed render returns its credit.
- [Ormas Outcomes](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ormas-outcomes.html) (added 2026-11-13): Ormas Outcomes is a local stdio MCP server for handing bounded GitHub coding tasks to Ormas, which runs on Bittensor subnet 76: each task gets a pinned base, agreed acceptance tests and a firm price or hard cap, and there is no task charge if acceptance fails. It is a US-only early alpha that needs an account, an API key, paid credits and consent to share code, and you review the result branch and receipt before merging.
- [deed.page](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/deed-page.html) (added 2026-11-13): deed.page is static web hosting built for AI agents: one HTTP PUT or POST, or a call to its native MCP server at deed.page/mcp, publishes files to a permanent HTTPS URL at a slug the agent picks, with no signup, emailed code, claim link or 24-hour expiry. The reply includes a token for later updates and version restore; the free plan covers 25 sites of 25 MB, with paid plans from $4 a month.
- [TikFilmer](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tikfilmer.html) (added 2026-11-13): TikFilmer is an AI film maker that takes a story or script through a guided pipeline: screenplay, consistent characters and assets, scene breakdown, storyboards, generated video clips and a rough cut. An estimate-first Autopilot can run the whole pass, and you can switch one project between a card view and a canvas. A free plan includes 350 credits.
- [ReelAI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/reelai.html) (added 2026-11-13): ReelAI turns a single photo or a text prompt into a vertical short video for TikTok and Instagram Reels, using MiniMax and Seedance motion models and preset motion templates, with audio included, no watermark and commercial rights. Paid plans start at $19.90 a month.
- [KDPTop](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/kdptop.html) (added 2026-11-13): KDPTop is a book-research tool for Amazon KDP self-publishers: it tracks Amazon Books and Kindle best-seller rankings across more than 10,000 niche lists, as often as every three hours, with sales and royalty estimates, keyword search volume, author data and AI briefs on whether a niche is worth writing for. A free category finder, a Chrome extension and an API are available alongside paid plans.
- [402Proof](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/402proof.html) (added 2026-11-13): 402Proof is ScriptMasterLabs' payment facilitator for paid APIs and agent services: it settles native XRP payments on XRPL and exact USDC payments on Solana through the x402 protocol, with a separate native XAH invoice rail on Xahau. The merchant pays a listed $0.01 per successful settlement with no monthly subscription, onboarding is partner-keyed, and a public attestation page shows each control as implemented with live evidence links.
- [Poki](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/poki.html) (added 2026-11-12): Poki is an AGPL-3.0 local MCP server and agent that lets AI agents operate a real iPhone the way you do, with no jailbreak and no extra hardware. Your coding agent installs it from the repo over a USB cable from a Mac (macOS 14+, iOS 18+, free Apple Account), and you only confirm the trust and Developer Mode prompts iOS asks for.
- [AI DevKit](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ai-devkit.html) (added 2026-11-12): AI DevKit is an Apache-2.0 control plane for AI coding agents that gives Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and others one local-first layer: a shared .ai-devkit.json config, a live TUI console to supervise running sessions, cross-agent messaging, local SQLite memory that agents search on demand, and composable engineering skills led by dev-lifecycle.
- [Minutes](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/minutes.html) (added 2026-11-12): Minutes is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first conversation memory app, an open alternative to Granola or Otter: it records and transcribes meetings, calls, voice memos and dictation on your device into Markdown files you own, then lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client search the history you choose to share. It ships as a desktop app and a CLI.
- [AbacusAI Bot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/abacusai-bot.html) (added 2026-11-12): AbacusAI Bot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for building personal agent bots: give each bot a name, instructions and a model, and it keeps its own chat and memory, works in Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Notion and other connected services, runs on a schedule and can be messaged from the desktop, WhatsApp, Telegram or Discord. Bot routines run with full tool permissions, so scope connections carefully.
- [devvm](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/devvm.html) (added 2026-11-12): devvm is an MIT-licensed tool that gives every project its own isolated VM with the project's toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start work without touching your host. It installs with Homebrew on macOS (using Lima) or a signed install script on Linux, and devvm doctor checks and explains anything your machine is missing.
- [SolonGate Agent Security](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/solongate-agent-security.html) (added 2026-11-12): SolonGate Agent Security is an Apache-2.0, local-first security gateway for AI coding agents: it hooks into agent sessions to check every tool call against a policy file before it runs, detects secrets, applies rate limits and writes a local audit trail. It makes no network calls and needs no account or telemetry; install it with the repo's script (Go 1.26+).
- [Yogurt](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/yogurt.html) (added 2026-11-12): Yogurt is Frigade's free, MIT-licensed AI meeting notes app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It records calls without adding a bot to the meeting, transcribes live in 99 languages, writes summaries from the conversation and your notes, names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet on Mac, and keeps audio, transcripts and AI processing on your computer with no account needed.
- [Genex Desktop](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/genex-desktop.html) (added 2026-11-12): Genex Desktop is an MIT-licensed app for making games with AI in Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot or the browser: the agent sets up the engine, builds the game and play-tests it by itself. It works with your Claude Code or ChatGPT subscription or local models, mixes models across main agent, workers and reviewers, and makes 3D assets locally through a Blender plugin; builds are for macOS, Linux and a Windows preview.
- [agentes.chat](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/agentes-chat.html) (added 2026-11-12): agentes.chat is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents share channels and DMs. Agents join with a role, an owner and a budget, think with Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Grok or any OpenRouter model, use MCP tools, get their own computer and browser, run routines, keep memory and ask before sensitive actions. It has web, desktop and phone apps, self-hosts with Docker Compose and Postgres, and also runs as a hosted cloud.
- [Crabbox](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/crabbox.html) (added 2026-11-12): Crabbox is an MIT-licensed tool from the OpenClaw team that gives coding agents and humans an on-demand computer for tests, builds and UI checks while they keep editing locally. Run crabbox run -- pnpm test and it leases a cloud box, local VM, container or your own machine, syncs your working tree including uncommitted changes, streams the output back and returns the exit code.
- [AVA (AntV)](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ava-antv.html) (added 2026-11-12): AVA is AntV's MIT-licensed AI-native visual analytics framework, described as PandasAI for JavaScript: it brings natural-language data analysis and charting to your apps and AI agents, with one interface to files and databases, inspectable queries behind each answer, question-guided chart recommendations, local execution with your chosen model endpoint and published accuracy benchmarks.
- [Bub](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/bub.html) (added 2026-11-12): Bub is an Apache-2.0 tiny agent runtime for Python 3.12+: use its agent kernel to pick a model, tools, instructions and conversation storage inside your own program and serve it with FastAPI, or run the Bub app and extend it with tools, skills, plugins and chat channels from its hub.
- [CyberVerse](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cyberverse.html) (added 2026-11-12): CyberVerse is a GPL-3.0, self-hosted framework for real-time digital-human agents: it builds voice-first AI agents over WebRTC with persona memory, tools and RAG, and can add a talking digital-human video generated from a single photo. It suits teams that want a JARVIS-style assistant or avatar agent they run on their own infrastructure.
- [Sheprd](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sheprd.html) (added 2026-11-12): Sheprd is an Apache-2.0 native workspace for terminals and AI coding agents on macOS, Linux and Windows, built in Rust with GPUI. It organises repositories, Git worktrees, tabs and splits, lets you chat with agents, review their changes and track pull requests and usage across local, SSH and cloud machines, and adds browser previews, automations and phone remote control on top of a Herdr terminal daemon.
- [dstack](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/dstack.html) (added 2026-11-12): dstack is an MPL-2.0 control plane for GPU provisioning and orchestration across GPU clouds, Kubernetes, VMs and on-prem or bare-metal clusters. It standardises how teams run development environments, training and inference on NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU and Tenstorrent hardware, with gateways, a Slurm backend, NVIDIA Dynamo integration and presets for agent-driven inference optimisation.
- [TrustGraph](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/trustgraph.html) (added 2026-11-12): TrustGraph is an Apache-2.0 ontology runtime for AI agents: it turns your documents and data into ontology-grounded knowledge graphs built on W3C standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, PROV-O) and governs what each agent and user can see. It is aimed at enterprises where agent decisions carry real risk, keeps your ontology, knowledge and audit trail portable and self-hosted, and has a playground, Docker images and a PyPI package.
- [Nod](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nod.html) (added 2026-11-12): Nod is n8n's Apache-2.0 personal agent with its own computer: it chases invoices, preps one-page call briefs from your mail, calendar and client news, drafts replies and cancels trials on real websites, and asks for approval before it sends, pays or speaks for you. It runs on your machine (macOS, with Windows and Linux previews) with a ChatGPT plan or your own AI key and works across Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion and the web.

It drives the subscriptions you already have rather than reselling tokens, lets you switch models or hand a task from one agent to another mid-thread, and supports remote machines over your LAN or Tailscale.
- [AI Calculators](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ai-calculators.html) (added 2026-11-12): AI Calculators is a free set of 26 client-side calculators for teams running AI in production: estimate LLM API spend and compare model pricing, prompt caching, token counts, context windows, RAG chunking and embedding budgets, vision image tokens, agent cost per task, voice-agent cost per minute, model routing and LLM VRAM sizing. Everything runs in your browser.

It uses a single weekly limit instead of short lockouts, lets you keep going on credits past the limit, and says it keeps none of your code; plans start at $20 a month.

Plans start at $19.99 a month for 380 credits, with one-time credit packs also available.

## Launches and status

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- The $99 weekly sponsorship includes submissions to about 25 other AI directories, with a report of the links. Refunds: https://agentscouthq.com/refunds.html
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).

## Community Grok Bot templates

- [PR Reviewer](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-pr-reviewer): Reviews pull requests for risk, missing tests, and thin context so review starts with the scary diff. Leads with what can break, what is untested.
- [Agent Looper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-agent-looper): You say what to build and how to know it's done. It keeps a coding agent working on your computer until that check passes.
- [Examiner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-examiner): Maintain a reliable timeline of important changes so you can reconstruct what happened when something later goes wrong. Isolated: talk only to you.
- [AI Harness Assistant](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-harness-assistant): Keeps the AI coding tools you already have, like Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Cursor, current on your Windows, Mac, and Linux machines.
- [GreenBuild](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-greenbuild): A senior QA and test-automation lead for testers and dev teams. It turns requirements into test plans and triages flaky tests.
- [UI/UX/Designer. Product Engineer 1000x](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-1000x-product-engineer): World-class product engineer for mobile and desktop web. Ships Convex + TanStack + React end to end. Simple, intuitive UI with real taste.
- [illo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-illo): Editorial illustration bot that uses the illo skill (tmchow/illo-skill) to turn ideas, posts, and announcements into mascot-led images on Grok Bot.
- [Design Expert](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-design-expert): A product design lead that keeps AI-built UIs honest.
- [Fabrication](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-fabrication): Takes your parts from CAD design to a finished 3D print. It checks fit, flat bed faces and hole sizes, and shows previews.
- [Churn retention manager](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-churn-retention-manager): Catches churn before it lands, offers a real alternative, and reports why people left. For businesses saving cancellations and failed payments.
- [Echo](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-echo): Turns a customer call into slides from customer context. What we heard, next steps, project initiatives, or all of the above.
- [Events](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-events): A market and pop-up inventory desk for small sellers. It builds pack lists before a show and logs what sold afterward.
- [Go Direct](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-go-direct): Skip the press. Lulu helps founders tell their story straight to the 50 to 500 people who actually matter: investors, early customers, future hires.
- [LinkedIn Desk](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-linkedin-desk): LinkedIn Desk helps you keep network quality high without living in LinkedIn, by reviewing connection requests and LinkedIn invitations.
- [Meeting to Money](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-sumosign): Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.
- [DOGE (Department of Grok Efficiency)](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-chief-of-staff-avid): A Grok Bot whose only job is to audit your other bots and routines, flag what to cut or merge, and find bottlenecks.
- [Watchdog](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-watchdog): On first install, scans email once as soon as Gmail is ready, then weekly for receipts, renewals, and trials.
- [AIUsageBot](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-ai-usage-meter): Interviews you about which AI subscriptions to track and where leftover lives (local CLIs, apps), then pings remaining % as it drops.
- [SlowBooks Cutover](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-slowbooks-cutover): Migrate one QuickBooks Desktop company into SlowBooks via Conductor (read-only), then prove Trial Balance and spot-check P&L.
- [Newsletter Cleanup](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-newsletter-cleanup): Audits Gmail newsletters (last 6 months), builds a three-bucket review.html, then unsubscribes only what you approve. Never deletes mail.
- [Bot inbox](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bot-inbox): A weekday unread digest for Grok Bots. Lists bots and group chats with new activity, one line each. Type scan anytime.
- [Dewey](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-dewey): Watches Gmail and pings you when a message looks time-sensitive or needs a reply. Reads freely; never sends, replies, or trashes mail unless you ask.
- [Harper](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-harper): An executive assistant for email, calendar, and texting. It triages your inbox, schedules people, protects deep-work time.
- [Backpack](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-backpack): Reads school and activity emails you don't have time for and turns them into calendar events, reminders, and a weekly family plan.
- [BFCM Email Planner](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-bfcm-email-planner): Plans your full Black Friday / Cyber Monday email and SMS calendar: sends, segments, offer angles, subject lines.
- [Be Happier](https://agentscouthq.com/bot-templates/#cb-be-happier): Looks at your email and calendar each week, then suggests 3 concrete things that would make you happier. Protects existing life, does not add new habits.
